Presenting the full video song "Gann Deva" from the Bollywood movie Street Dancer 3D. This latest track " Gann Deva " is sung by Divya Kumar, Sachin-Jigar and the music is by Sachin-Jigar.
Gulshan Kumar And T-Series Present A T-Series Films Production In Association With Remo D’Souza Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. & Dance Film Company Ltd. Uk, Bhushan Kumar’s Street Dancer 3D. The film is starring Varun Dhawan, Shraddha Kapoor, Nora Fatehi, and Prabhu Deva in lead roles and directed by Remo D'Souza, produced by Bhushan Kumar, Divya Khosla Kumar, Krishan Kumar & Lizelle D’Souza.
